name: Makhaon
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 3063 Makhaon: diameter 111.655 ± 1.544 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[jupiter_trojans] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759...49G)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 111.655 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Makhaon. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: L. G. Karachkina found Makhaon at Nauchnyj on 4 August 1983.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 111.655 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
